bio: Take time to relax, unwind and indulge, with a decadent Afternoon Tea for two at The Gilt Rooms. Located in Colchester, the pretty tea room boasts freshly baked pastries, finger sandwiches and delightful mini scones. Share the moment with a guest of your choice, whilst you both enjoy the sweet, satisfying tastes along with 90 minutes of bottomless prosecco!  Perfect for a special occasion or simply a ‘treat yourself’, The Gilt Rooms provide all guests with an exquisite dining experience, centred around impeccable service, tasty food and community.
